example.title: Corner block on the courthouse square (barber shop, cafe)

brief: Two-storey corner commercial block in a university town whose whole upper facade was wrapped in a 1960s horizontal metal slipcover panel (painted pale grey), hiding the old brick and windows. At street level a continuous flat metal canopy shades plate-glass storefronts; a small flat signboard on the canopy fascia and a painted sign on the slipcover. Street trees and a signal mast arm at the corner.

storefronts.sign: SQUARE DEAL CAFE - BREAKFAST ALL DAY
